label: The nature of a being whose esse is its essence is not received in matter
paraphrase: For every x whose represented esse equals its represented essence, x's nature is not received in matter (not InMatter x). Reading of De ente c.3 [69874] (Baur/Koch; Leonine c.4): 'et multo minus reciperet additionem materiae, quia iam esset esse non subsistens sed materiale'.
